leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply React Context to create a centralized state management solution for components.
Implement the Context.Provider component to wrap and supply state to a component tree.
Utilize the useContext hook to access context values within functional components.
Construct a custom provider component that encapsulates context logic and state management.
Define context types using TypeScript interfaces to ensure type safety across the application.
Use memoization techniques (React.memo) to prevent unnecessary re-renders of child components.
Apply useMemo to compute and cache expensive values derived from context state.
Implement useCallback to memoize callback functions passed through context to child components.
Control component re-renders by splitting context into multiple providers for independent state slices.
Access and modify context state through dedicated functions to maintain predictable state updates.
Compare performance before and after optimization using React DevTools Profiler.
Return optimized component trees that minimize re-renders while maintaining functional requirements.
